requirements.sourceQuote: To qualify for the Master's in Management, applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree (requiring at least six semesters of study) or equivalent in Engineering (Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering and Surveying, Architecture, or equivalent), or Natural Sciences (Natural Sciences, Computer Science, Mathematics, Nutritional Science, Sports Science, or equivalent).

English language skills
**C1** required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: 
  * TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 88 
  * PTE Academic: 65 
  * Cambridge English Qualifications: C1 Advanced 
  * IELTS Academic: 6.5

All applicants with a Bachelor’s degree from China, Bangladesh, India, Egypt, and Pakistan must submit a GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test) with at least 65% percentile ranking with their application.
The new GMAT Focus Edition will also be accepted with a score of at least 585.
Additional application via uni-assist if you did not obtain your Bachelor's degree at a German university

All applicants who wish to apply for a degree programme at a German university with a**Chinese, Indian, or Vietnamese** school or university degree need a certificate from the**Academic Evaluation Centre**([Akademische Prüfstelle, APS](https://www.tum.de/en/studies/application/application-info-portal/aps)).
